model: engine/physics/collision.ts simulate() — PH-1 lanes, MV-1 piecewise-constant kinematics, PH-2 encounter rules; event-driven, exact event times
lateral_note: native 1-D model: u = 0 imposed (no lateral coordinate); the 2-D judge therefore sees every wide-lane pass as bodies on one centre-line

scenario.title: 兩隻迎面：狹窄通道（1.0 mm 可用寬度）

length_mm.why: 小工蟻體長約 2.5 mm（R94，文獻支持）

width_mm.why: value 為 null；取候選範圍上限 0.8 mm（與 tests/ph2-collision.test.ts 的 wHi 相同），只作敏感度，非量測

contact_reach_mm.why: value 為 null；取候選範圍中點 1.0 mm（與 tests/ph2-collision.test.ts 相同），只作敏感度，非量測

encounter_provenance.priority: scenarios/physics/pheidole-megacephala.interaction-candidates.json#encounter.priority.value [遊戲假設（選擇）] 檔案預設
encounter_provenance.entry_yield_probability: scenarios/physics/pheidole-megacephala.interaction-candidates.json#encounter.entry_yield_probability.value [文獻支持（非本種：Lasius niger）] 非本種 Lasius niger 202/211（R380）
encounter_provenance.laden_yield_probability: scenarios/physics/pheidole-megacephala.interaction-candidates.json#encounter.laden_yield_probability.value [文獻支持（非本種：Atta colombica）] 非本種 Atta colombica（R381）；本情境無負載，不會用到
encounter_provenance.contact_pause_s: scenarios/physics/pheidole-megacephala.interaction-candidates.json#encounter.contact_pause_s.value = null (file value; engine null case) 檔案值 null＝不停頓
encounter_provenance.inside_turn_back_probability: scenarios/physics/pheidole-megacephala.interaction-candidates.json#encounter.inside_turn_back_probability.candidate_values.1 [遊戲假設] 檔案 value 為 null；取候選值 0.5（與 tests/ph2-collision.test.ts 相同，遊戲假設）。若改為 null，原生模型會回報 unresolved

provenance.scenario_values: 起點、橫向偏移、出發時間、時間長度與種子都是合成情境值（遊戲假設），不是量測，也不是臺中西屯花園。
provenance.note: 同 tests/ph2-collision.test.ts §1 的起點與目標（W1 2→98，W2 98→2）。

cost_note: cost = second (warm) run; cost_first_run includes module warm-up

judge.obstacle_depth_note: circle: exact depth; polygon: a capsule whose axis touches or enters the polygon is reported with depth ≥ its radius (lower bound)

occupancy2d.note: checkOccupancy2D with each body in its OWN lane band and layer = level; at a crossing a body inside the other lane band is reported outside_lane by this contract

judge_dense.obstacle_depth_note: circle: exact depth; polygon: a capsule whose axis touches or enters the polygon is reported with depth ≥ its radius (lower bound)

notes: native PH-2 is 1-D along each lane: no lateral degree of freedom; converted with u = 0 (centre-line) unless stated
